hints.TestSum: var total T; for _, x := range xs { total += x }; return total
hints.TestMax: if len(xs) == 0 { var zero T; return zero, false }; m := xs[0]; loop and compare with >.
hints.TestContains: Range and compare with ==, which comparable allows. (slices.Contains does the same.)
hints.TestMap: out := make([]U, 0, len(xs)); for _, x := range xs { out = append(out, f(x)) }
hints.TestFilter: Append x when keep(x) is true.
hints.TestStack: Push: append. Pop: if empty return zero, false; v := s.items[len(s.items)-1]; s.items = s.items[:len(s.items)-1].
